items.title: 基于多模态大模型辅助视频动作生成的预训练世界模型
items.title_zh: 基于多模态大模型辅助视频动作生成的预训练世界模型
items.summary_zh: 预训练世界模型是提升强化学习样本效率的关键技术,但现有方法因视频数据缺乏显式动作标注,难以捕捉状态转移的因果机制。对此,提出多模态大模型辅助的视频动作生成预训练框架(MLM-generated Action-based Pre-training from videos for world models,MAPO),通过整合视觉语言模型的语义理解能力与动力学建模需求,突破传统预训练范式在动作语义缺失方面的局限性。具体地,MAPO在预训练阶段利用多模态大模型(QWEN2_5-VL-7B)解析视频帧序列,生成细粒度语义动作描述,构建具有因果解释性的动作-状态关联;设计上下文量化编码机制,解耦场景静态特征与动态控制因素,增强跨模态表征能力。在微调阶段,通过双网络协同架构实现预训练动力学特征与真实环境动作的端到端对齐。实验表明,MAPO在DeepMind Control Suite和Meta-Wor

extra.description: 预训练世界模型是提升强化学习样本效率的关键技术,但现有方法因视频数据缺乏显式动作标注,难以捕捉状态转移的因果机制。对此,提出多模态大模型辅助的视频动作生成预训练框架(MLM-generated Action-based Pre-training from videos for world models,MAPO),通过整合视觉语言模型的语义理解能力与动力学建模需求,突破传统预训练范式在动作语义缺失方面的局限性。具体地,MAPO在预训练阶段利用多模态大模型(QWEN2_5-VL-7B)解析视频帧序列,生成细粒度语义动作描述,构建具有因果解释性的动作-状态关联;设计上下文量化编码机制,解耦场景静态特征与动态控制因素,增强跨模态表征能力。在微调阶段,通过双网络协同架构实现预训练动力学特征与真实环境动作的端到端对齐。实验表明,MAPO在DeepMind Control Suite和Meta-World的8项任务中的平均回报较最优基线获得稳定提升,尤其在长时程任务中展现出卓越的性能。该研究为跨模态世界模型训练提供了新范式,揭示了语义动作生成在因果推理中的关键作用。

items.title: MUSS: A Multi-scale and Sequence-based Model for Single-cell Gene Regulation
items.title_zh: MUSS：一个用于单细胞基因调控的多尺度且基于序列的模型
items.summary_zh: 在单细胞中建模基因调控需要跨调控尺度联合表示DNA序列、染色质可及性和基因表达。基于序列的模型捕获DNA水平的调控语法，但通常缺乏细胞水平的分辨率，而许多单细胞组学模型将基因和峰表示为固定词汇的标记，而没有其底层序列。在这里，我们提出了MUSS，一个基于序列的单细胞基因调控多尺度模型，同时保留DNA水平和细胞水平的分辨率。MUSS使用冻结的预训练序列编码器从DNA推导峰和基因水平的表示，并通过峰-峰自注意力和距离偏置的峰-基因相互作用进行整合。峰掩码语言建模随后在配对的scATAC-seq和scRNA-seq上训练，将这些表示与细胞特异性调控状态对齐。在基因表达预测、增强子-基因连接、基序引导的调控优先级排序和零样本细胞聚类方面，MUSS相对于基于序列和单细胞组学的基线取得了强劲性能。它进一步预测任务训练期间未见过的基因和峰的表达。这些结果支持基于序列的多尺度表示用于解码细胞类型特异性调控

extra.description: Modeling gene regulation in single cells requires jointly representing DNA sequence, chromatin accessibility, and gene expression across regulatory scales. Sequence-based models capture DNA-level regulatory grammar but often lack cell-level resolution, whereas many single-cell omics models represent genes and peaks as fixed-vocabulary tokens without their underlying sequence. Here, we present MUSS, a sequence-based multi-scale model for single-cell gene regulation that preserves both DNA-level and cell-level resolution. MUSS derives peak- and gene-level representations from DNA using a frozen pre-trained sequence encoder and integrates them through peak-peak self-attention and distance-biased peak-gene interactions. Peak masked language modeling followed by training on paired scATAC-seq and scRNA-seq aligns these representations with cell-specific regulatory states. Across gene expression prediction, enhancer-gene linking, motif-guided regulatory prioritization, and zero-shot cell clustering, MUSS achieves strong performance against sequence-based and single-cell omics baselines. It further predicts expression for genes and peaks unseen during task training. These results support sequence-grounded, multi-scale representations for decoding cell-type-specific regulatory programs. Code, datasets, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/Lotfollahi-lab/MUSS_neurips26.

items.title: Fisher-Glass Learning: Classification Bounds and Subpopulation Audits
items.title_zh: Fisher-Glass学习：分类边界与亚群审计
items.summary_zh: 当背景线索发生变化而不改变正确标签时，准确的分类器可能会失败。仅凭预测性能无法量化在考虑此类 nuisance 变化后还保留多少任务信息。在这里，我们扩展了Fisher-glass框架，将 nuisance 调整后的信息与局部分类难度和亚群审计联系起来。我们在明确的区分性和决策分离条件下推导了局部 minimax 超额分类风险的下界，以及考虑估计误差和正则化的统计审计。在Waterbirds上，基于任务-背景对齐的特征诊断选择了一个被准确分类的组，选择在留出评估之前冻结。在五个训练种子中，保留提取的鸟前景和标签的背景替换在背景类型保留时产生93.2%的准确率，在背景类型改变时产生40.6%的准确率，受控差异为52.6个百分点。另外，使用任务标签和固定 nuisance 方向进行搜索，识别出一个独立评估的群体，其成员加权准确率为98.8%，估计的投影预测Fisher信息较低。训练和获取实验表

extra.description: Accurate classifiers can fail when background cues change without altering the correct labels. Predictive performance alone does not quantify how much task information remains after accounting for such nuisance variation. Here we extend the Fisher-glass framework to connect nuisance-adjusted information with local classification difficulty and subpopulation auditing. We derive lower bounds on local minimax excess classification risk under explicit distinguishability and decision-separation conditions, alongside statistical audits accounting for estimation error and regularization. On Waterbirds, a feature-based diagnostic of task-background alignment selects an accurately classified group, with selection frozen before held-out evaluation. Across five training seeds, background replacements preserving the extracted bird foreground and labels yield 93.2% accuracy when background type is preserved and 40.6% when it changes, a controlled difference of 52.6 percentage points. Separately, search using task labels and a fixed nuisance direction identifies an independently evaluated population with 98.8% membership-weighted accuracy and low estimated projected predictive Fisher information. Training and acquisition experiments show that information gains and predictive gains can diverge. These findings support joint assessment of predictive performance, information under declared nuisance models and controlled sensitivity when diagnosing vulnerability and evaluating model improvements.

items.title: Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞转录组图谱的可复现量子聚类
items.summary_zh: 当前的单细胞聚类流程丢弃了大多数基因，并且在不同随机种子下可能产生不一致的聚类。我们介绍了KQE-2，一个无需训练的混合量子-经典框架，用于可复现的全转录组聚类。KQE-2将细胞映射到无纠缠的量子态，使得能够在经典硬件上进行精确的特征评估，并在量子处理器上直接检查。在理论上，我们证明了消除纠缠是局部限制单量子比特特征方差的必要且充分条件。在实践中，虽然重新训练scVI使14%的细胞发生偏移并改变了稀有类型标记和药物靶点，但KQE-2在多次运行中提供了相同的生物学结果。在标准高变基因上，仅量子编码就将发育中皮层的准确率从0.61提高到0.79。KQE-2可在一台服务器上扩展到1140万个细胞核，在十个完整图谱中的八个上优于所比较的方法（在两个上处于最佳方法的运行间范围内），并且即使在标准下游聚类下也在六个上领先。

extra.description: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.

items.title: HELICS: Biobank-scale Conditional Synthetic Genome Generation via Latent Flow Matching
items.title_zh: HELICS：通过潜在流匹配进行生物样本库规模的条件合成基因组生成
items.summary_zh: 个体水平基因型数据支撑遗传发现、疾病风险建模和治疗开发，然而许多关键场景仍数据有限，包括代表性不足的祖先群体、罕见或不平衡疾病队列以及受限访问的生物样本库。条件合成基因组生成将支持隐私感知的基准测试、模拟和数据增强，但需要学习数十万至数千万相关单核苷酸多态性（SNPs，即DNA变异位点）上的超高维离散分布。我们引入HELICS：通过潜在插值条件合成的高保真生成，一个无定相潜在流匹配框架，用于从生物样本库规模基因型数据进行全基因组SNP水平生成。HELICS用卷积自编码器对染色体进行标记化，将>600K SNPs缩减为4,096个连续潜在标记，并在拼接的多染色体潜在表示上训练参数化条件流匹配的transformer模型。在英国生物样本库超过417K基因组上训练，HELICS无需单倍型定相即可生成全基因组常见变异合成队列，并比现有基于单倍型的模拟器更忠实于真实基因型，包括外部评估中高等位基因频

extra.description: Individual-level genotype data underpin genetic discovery, disease-risk modeling, and therapeutic development, yet many critical settings remain data-limited, including underrepresented ancestries, rare or imbalanced disease cohorts, and restricted-access biobanks. Conditional synthetic genome generation would support privacy-aware benchmarking, simulation, and data augmentation, but requires learning an ultra-high-dimensional discrete distribution over hundreds of thousands to tens of millions of correlated single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), or sites of DNA variation. We introduce HELICS: High-fidelity gEneration via Latent Interpolant Conditional Synthesis, a phasing-free latent flow matching framework for genome-wide SNP-level generation from biobank-scale genotype data. HELICS tokenizes chromosomes with convolutional autoencoders, reducing >600K SNPs to 4,096 continuous latent tokens, and trains a transformer parameterized conditional flow matching model over the concatenated multi-chromosome latent representation. Trained on over 417K genomes in the UK Biobank, HELICS generates genome-wide common-variant synthetic cohorts without haplotype phasing and achieves stronger fidelity to real genotypes than existing haplotype-based simulators, including high allele-frequency agreement in external evaluation and superior preservation of local and long-range SNP correlation structure. Conditioning on ancestry and genetic liability summaries enables targeted generation across genetic risk profiles; in perturbation analyses, by increasing the conditioned disease trait liability, HELICS induces SNP-level dosage changes in generated genomes that are highly correlated with published association weights. HELICS provides a scalable generative modeling framework for SNP-level genome data and a path toward conditional synthetic cohorts for data-limited genetic studies.

items.title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
items.title_zh: 融合图学习与成对学习，从scRNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络
items.summary_zh: 动机：基因调控网络（GRNs）捕捉转录因子（TFs）调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有GRN推断方法大致分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整体图；基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法都有局限性，而这些局限恰恰是另一方的优势。基于图的方法因依赖单一训练图而容易过拟合，而成对方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶基因训练对。相反，成对方法忽略了全局拓扑结构，而这对全面捕捉调控机制至关重要。结果：为解决这些局限，我们提出scGPL，一个端到端统一框架，联合建模全局调控拓扑和局部相互作用。scGPL从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并引入动态的、重要性引导的子图采样机制以捕捉细粒度局部依赖。通过融合全局表示与子图增强的局部特征，我们的框架弥合了两种范式之间的差距，既纳入必要的全图拓扑依赖，又保留成对方法的数据丰富优势。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，scGPL持

extra.description: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. Availability and implementation: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.

items.title: stMIND: Learning multiscale interaction dynamics from spatial-temporal transcriptomics
items.title_zh: stMIND：从时空转录组学习多尺度相互作用动力学
items.summary_zh: 局部细胞邻域内以及跨更广泛组织尺度的相互作用共同调控发育和再生过程中的分子状态转变和形态发生。虽然时间分辨空间转录组学同时分析基因表达和空间坐标，但破坏性测序在每个时间点采样不同的细胞，留下中间轨迹和多尺度细胞间相互作用未被观察。在我们相互作用的平均场神经随机微分方程框架基础上，我们提出了stMIND（时空多尺度相互作用神经动力学），一个连续时间生成框架，从非匹配的时空快照推断耦合的分子、空间和增殖动力学。stMIND将细胞表达速度向量/漂移分解为三个可解释的算子：细胞内在程序、局部图差分注意力算子（在共同演化的物理半径内聚合相对表达差异和空间几何），以及非局部平均场注意力算子（捕捉超出紧邻邻域的远程群体背景）。通过随细胞迁移一起演化动态空间邻域，并强制内在漂移和相互作用驱动漂移之间的正交性，stMIND通过联合表达-位置空间中的最优传输解析尺度特异性细胞间影响。在蝾螈和斑马鱼基准中，st

extra.description: Interactions within local cellular neighborhoods and across broader tissue scales jointly govern molecular state transitions and morphogenesis during development and regeneration. While time-resolved spatial transcriptomics simultaneously profiles gene expression and spatial coordinates, destructive sequencing samples distinct cells at each time point, leaving intermediate trajectories and multiscale intercellular interactions unobserved. Building upon our interacting mean-field neural stochastic differential equation framework, we present stMIND (Spatiotemporal Multiscale Interaction Neural Dynamics), a continuous-time generative framework that infers coupled molecular, spatial, and proliferation dynamics from unmatched spatiotemporal snapshots. stMIND decomposes cellular expression velocity vector/drift into three interpretable operators: a cell-intrinsic program, a local graph-difference attention operator that aggregates relative expression differences and spatial geometry within a co-evolving physical radius, and a nonlocal mean-field attention operator that captures long-range population context beyond the immediate neighborhood. By evolving dynamic spatial neighborhoods alongside cellular migration and enforcing orthogonality between intrinsic and interaction-driven drifts, stMIND resolves scale-specific intercellular influences through optimal transport in joint expression-position space. In axolotl and zebrafish benchmarks, stMIND leads in expression prediction, anatomical consistency and spatial coherence. Ablations confirm the need to combine disjoint local and nonlocal operators. It reveals a regenerative transition in axolotl telencephalon 10 to 15 days after injury, with a drift energy surge followed by nonlocal dominance and local counterbalance varying by cell type in reactive ependymoglial niches. It tracks developmental vector fields across zebrafish stages.

items.title: Publications as benchmarks: auditing AI agents on spatial transcriptomics alignment
items.title_zh: 出版物作为基准：审计AI智能体在空间转录组对齐上的表现
items.summary_zh: AI智能体正越来越多地自动化数据分析，但负责任的采用需要可靠的性能评估，这在专业科学领域成本高昂。我们引入了一个框架，将科学出版物转化为AI智能体可审计的基准，并展示了其在空间转录组对齐任务上的应用。在121个任务、16个基线方法和六个AI智能体中，最佳智能体（GPT-6-Astra和Gemini-4-Argon）在80%的任务上匹配或优于所有基线，通常使用令人惊讶的简单启发式方法。智能体性能对提示和访问预安装包具有鲁棒性。基准构建还揭示了先前工作中的错误和当前评估指标中的捷径。最后，我们表明智能体生成的解决方案可以蒸馏成一个可重用的程序，在未见数据上排名前10%的基线方法。我们的框架提供了一种可扩展的方式，通过利用和压力测试现有论文和指标来评估专业科学领域中的AI智能体。

extra.description: AI agents are increasingly automating data analysis, but responsible adoption requires reliable performance evaluation, which is costly in specialized scientific domains. We introduce a framework that translates scientific publications into auditable benchmarks for AI agents and demonstrate its use on spatial transcriptomics alignment tasks. Across 121 tasks, 16 baseline methods, and six AI agents, the best agents (GPT-6-Astra and Gemini-4-Argon) matched or outperformed all baselines on 80% of tasks, often using surprisingly simple heuristics. Agent performance was robust to prompting and access to pre-installed packages. Benchmark construction also uncovered errors in prior work and shortcuts in current evaluation metrics. Finally, we show that agent-generated solutions can be distilled into a reusable program that ranks in the top 10% of baseline methods on unseen data. Our framework offers a scalable way to evaluate AI agents in specialized scientific domains by leveraging and stress-testing existing papers and metrics.

items.title: Synchronized Optimal Transport Reconstructs Coupled Transcriptomic and Chromatin Dynamics
items.title_zh: 同步最优传输重建耦合的转录组与染色质动态
items.summary_zh: 跨发育阶段收集的单细胞 RNA 和 ATAC 数据提供了转录和调控状态的时间进程快照。由于测序是破坏性的，这些快照之间的轨迹必须从独立采样的细胞群体中推断。现有方法通常在单一模态中推断连续动态，或在共享表示中整合 RNA 和 ATAC。在此我们提出跨组学对齐轨迹推断（COATI），它将非平衡同步动态最优传输扩展为时间依赖的跨模态映射，以在不同 RNA 和 ATAC 状态空间中重建耦合轨迹。我们在合成基准和四个发育数据集上使用留出阶段重建和谱系分析评估了 COATI。COATI 改善了留出阶段细胞群体的重建，包括恢复细胞类型内的染色质状态异质性，并更好地保留了发育谱系关系。非平衡形式允许推断群体质量变化，这些变化被证明与早期阶段的 DNA 复制程序和发育后期的谱系成熟程序相关。耦合轨迹使得分析发育过程中谱系特异的转录和染色质变化及其时间关系成为可能。COATI 推断的谱系响应与独立的 CRI

extra.description: Single-cell RNA and ATAC data collected across developmental stages provide time-course snapshots of transcriptional and regulatory states. Since sequencing is destructive, trajectories between these snapshots must be inferred from independently sampled cell populations. Existing approaches typically infer continuous dynamics in a single modality or integrate RNA and ATAC in a shared representation. Here we present Cross-Omics Aligned Trajectory Inference (COATI), which extends unbalanced synchronized dynamical optimal transport to time-dependent cross-modal maps for reconstructing coupled trajectories in distinct RNA and ATAC state spaces. We evaluated COATI on synthetic benchmarks and four developmental datasets using held-out-stage reconstruction and lineage analyses. COATI improved reconstruction of cell populations at held-out stages, including recovery of chromatin-state heterogeneity within cell types, and better preserved developmental lineage relationships. The unbalanced formulation allows the inference of population mass changes, which were shown to associate with DNA-replication programs at early stages and lineage-maturation programs later in development. The coupled trajectories enabled analysis of lineage-specific transcriptional and chromatin changes and their temporal relationships during development. Lineage responses inferred by COATI agreed with independent CRISPR perturbation results, and the inferred regulatory patterns were consistent with independent epigenetic data.

items.title: HistoTx: Early fusion of H&E images and spatial transcriptomics at varying spatial transcriptomics resolution with self-supervised learning
items.title_zh: HistoTx：在不同空间转录组学分辨率下，通过自监督学习对H&E图像和空间转录组学进行早期融合
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学绘制组织切片上的基因表达图谱，当与全切片图像整合时，可联合捕获形态结构和分子活动，从而提供组织生物学的丰富多模态视图。将空间转录组学与WSI结合的ML方法通常通过对比对齐或对病理基础模型进行监督微调，学习从形态特征到分子谱的映射。在这两种情况下，转录组学都作为训练信号而非真正的输入模态，使推理从根本上由图像驱动。我们提出一种早期融合视觉Transformer架构，其中转录组token以任意空间分辨率构建，与图像块token合并，并通过共享Transformer堆栈联合处理，以实现深度跨模态交互。从预训练的纯视觉病理基础模型出发，我们通过在配对的图像和空间转录组学数据上继续自监督预训练来训练HistoTx，并证明：1）在仅使用图像进行推理时，性能在大多数任务上与基线持平，同时在本质上受益于分子知识的任务（如基因表达预测）上有所提升；2）当推理时两种模态均可用时，联合提供图像和转录

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics maps gene expression across tissue sections and, when integrated with whole slide images, jointly captures both morphological architecture and molecular activity to provide a rich, multimodal view of tissue biology. ML approaches combining spatial transcriptomics and WSIs typically learn a mapping from morphological features to molecular profiles via contrastive alignment or supervised fine-tuning of pathology foundation models. In both cases, transcriptomics serves as a training signal rather than a true input modality, leaving inference fundamentally image-driven. We propose an early-fusion vision transformer architecture in which transcript tokens are constructed at arbitrary spatial resolution, merged with image patch tokens, and jointly processed through a shared transformer stack for deep cross-modal interaction. Starting from a pretrained vision-only pathology foundation model, we train HistoTx by continuing self-supervised pretraining on paired image and spatial transcriptomics data and demonstrate that: 1) at inference with image only, performance remains on par with the baseline on most tasks while improving on tasks that inherently benefit from molecular knowledge, such as gene expression prediction; 2) when both modalities are available at inference, jointly providing image and transcript inputs outperforms either modality alone.

items.title: MorphoANOVA: Dissecting Histology-Gene Expression Relationships in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: MorphoANOVA：解析空间转录组学中组织学-基因表达关系
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学（ST）测量组织架构内数百至数千个基因的表达，通常伴随组织学图像。然而，系统表征哪些基因与组织形态存在关联、这些关联是否在空间上变化，以及哪些基因在形态所捕获之外显示额外空间表达模式，仍然具有挑战性。在此我们介绍MorphoANOVA，一个基因层面的统计框架，用于表征ST所测基因的形态-表达关系。使用嵌套空间变系数模型和序贯ANOVA，MorphoANOVA评估与H&E衍生形态特征的切片范围关联、这些关联的位置特异性变化，以及在考虑所选特征后的额外空间变异。所得统计量支持基因优先级排序和通路富集分析，而空间成分图支持单个基因的解读。模拟展示了MorphoANOVA区分建模成分并恢复其空间模式的能力。应用于人类皮层和乳腺癌，识别出与不同形态-表达模式相关的生物程序，并揭示与细胞组成的独特关系。在三位HER2阳性乳腺癌患者中，侵袭性癌症标志基因一致表现出更强的位置特异性形态关联证据

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures the expression of hundreds to thousands of genes within tissue architecture, often accompanied by histology images. However, it remains challenging to systematically characterize which genes exhibit associations with tissue morphology, whether these associations vary spatially, and which genes show additional spatial expression patterns beyond those captured by morphology. Here we introduce MorphoANOVA, a gene-wise statistical framework for characterizing morphology--expression relationships across genes measured by ST. Using nested spatially varying coefficient models and sequential ANOVA, MorphoANOVA assesses slide-wide associations with an H\&E-derived morphology feature, location-specific changes in these associations, and additional spatial variation after accounting for the selected feature. The resulting statistics enable gene prioritization and pathway enrichment analysis, while spatial component maps support the interpretation of individual genes. Simulations demonstrate MorphoANOVA's ability to distinguish the modeled components and recover their spatial patterns. Applications to human cortex and breast cancer identify biological programs associated with different morphology--expression patterns and reveal distinct relationships with cell composition. Across three HER2-positive breast cancer patients, invasive-cancer marker genes consistently exhibit stronger evidence of location-specific morphology associations. MorphoANOVA thus provides a framework for systematically interpreting spatial gene-expression patterns in relation to tissue morphology.

items.title: Synaptic Dendritic Neuron Model (scDNM) for Cell Type Classification in Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Data
items.title_zh: 突触树突神经元模型（scDNM）用于单细胞RNA测序数据中的细胞类型分类
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中的细胞类型分类具有挑战性，因为存在高维度、稀疏性和转录相似的细胞类型。我们开发了scDNM，这是树突神经元模型的改编版，结合了可学习的突触阈值、监督基因池、分阶段训练和集成预测。从Paul15、PBMC3k和Nestorowa数据集构建了六个二分类任务。所有模型均使用无泄漏的嵌套交叉验证进行评估，特征选择、缩放和超参数调优独立于外部测试折进行。scDNM在六个任务中的三个中排名第一（包括一次并列），并取得了最佳平均准确率排名（2.00），其次是XGBoost（2.75）、随机森林（3.33）、逻辑回归（3.33）和SVM（3.58）。在六类PBMC3k实验中，scDNM达到了95.997%的准确率和0.944的宏F1，而SingleR为94.243%和0.914。Garnett仅返回Unknown标签，被视为零覆盖的技术结果。消融分析支持了树突和

extra.description: Cell type classification in single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data is challenging because of high dimensionality, sparsity, and transcriptionally similar cell types. We developed scDNM, an adaptation of the dendritic neuron model incorporating learnable synaptic thresholds, a supervised gene pool, staged training, and ensemble prediction. Six binary classification tasks were constructed from the Paul15, PBMC3k, and Nestorowa datasets. All models were evaluated using leakage-free nested cross-validation, with feature selection, scaling, and hyperparameter tuning performed independently of the outer test folds. scDNM ranked first in three of six tasks (including one tie) and achieved the best mean accuracy rank (2.00), followed by XGBoost (2.75), Random Forest (3.33), logistic regression (3.33), and SVM (3.58). In a six-class PBMC3k experiment, scDNM achieved 95.997% accuracy and 0.944 macro-F1, compared with 94.243% and 0.914 for SingleR. Garnett returned only Unknown labels and was treated as a zero-coverage technical outcome. Ablation analysis supported the contributions of dendrites and synaptic thresholds. However, XGBoost achieved higher mean binary-task accuracy (96.20% versus 95.32% for scDNM), and across-task rank differences were not statistically significant. These findings demonstrate that scDNM is competitive for scRNA-seq cell type classification, although broader independent validation is required.

items.title: Medical Image Segmentation: Foundation Model Adaptation versus Task-Specific Training
items.title_zh: 医学图像分割：基础模型适配与任务特定训练
items.summary_zh: 在大型自然图像集合上预训练的基础模型正越来越多地被适配用于医学图像分割，期望它们能取代为每个任务训练的模型。然而，大多数比较使用来自训练分布的数据和单一任务特定基线，其配置很少被论证，因此对新临床站点性能的证据有限。基础模型需要适配多少以及什么决定这一点仍不清楚。我们适配了一个基础模型DINOv2，策略从仅调优其偏置项到完全微调，并与从头训练的U-Net和ResU-Net进行比较。实验涵盖结肠镜、乳腺超声和皮肤镜，在来自训练来源的留出数据和其他机构的独立数据集上测试。适配后的基础模型在每个外部数据集上泛化更好。在训练分布内，当训练数据充足时，任务特定模型仍具竞争力，且边界描绘更精确，而基础模型更常遗漏小病变。只有一小部分基础模型需要适配，所需容量由成像域而非适配方法决定。还发现一个广泛使用的息肉测试集重复了另一个基准的图像。因此，在模型必须跨站点工作时，基础模型适配是合理的，容量应根据目标

extra.description: Foundation models pretrained on large natural-image collections are increasingly adapted for medical image segmentation, in the expectation that they will replace models trained for each task. Most comparisons, however, use data from the training distribution and a single task-specific baseline whose configuration is rarely justified, and therefore provide limited evidence of performance at new clinical sites. It also remains unclear how much of a foundation model must be adapted, and what determines this. We adapted a foundation model, DINOv2, with strategies ranging from tuning only its bias terms to full fine-tuning, and compared it with U-Nets and ResU-Nets trained from scratch. Experiments covered colonoscopy, breast ultrasound and dermoscopy, with testing on held-out data from the training source and on independent datasets from other institutions. The adapted foundation model generalised better on every external dataset. Within the training distribution, the task-specific models remained competitive when training data were abundant, and delineated boundaries more precisely, while the foundation model more often missed small lesions. Only a small fraction of the foundation model required adaptation, and the capacity needed was determined by the imaging domain rather than by the adaptation method. A widely used polyp test set was also found to duplicate images from another benchmark. Foundation-model adaptation is therefore warranted where models must work across sites, with capacity selected on the target domain.

items.title: Toward Foundation Detection Models via Example-Based Grounding in EM-DETR
items.title_zh: 通过EM-DETR中基于示例的定位迈向基础检测模型
items.summary_zh: 基于深度学习（DL）的计算机辅助诊断（CAD）系统在支持临床医生方面显示出巨大前景，但其性能严重依赖大量标注良好的数据集的可用性。在医学病变检测中，全面、标准化标注的稀缺和现有数据集的异质性限制了稳健基础模型的开发。在本工作中，我们引入一种新方法，通过整合为解剖结构和异常标注的多样医学图像数据集，构建用于病变检测的多域基础模型。我们首先提出一种学生-教师训练策略，有效结合具有异质标签空间的数据集，减轻灾难性遗忘并改善特征学习。此外，基于我们之前提出的基于示例的EM-DETR框架，我们将其适配为从多个域特定数据集联合学习，实现跨模态的细粒度、示例驱动检测。我们的模型达到最先进（SOTA）结果，在CXR的四个关键发现上图像级AUC分数超过先前SOTA 1个百分点。我们在CXR和乳腺X线摄影中达到领先的mAP50，超过在单一数据集上训练的EM-DETR 2-3个百分点。该方法为医学成像中利用异质

extra.description: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated datasets. In medical lesion detection, the scarcity of comprehensive, stan dardized annotations and the heterogeneity of existing datasets limit the development of robust foundation models. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to building a multi-domain foundation model for le sion detection by integrating diverse medical image datasets annotated for both anatomical structures and abnormalities. We first propose a student-teacher training strategy to effectively combine datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and im proving feature learning. In addition, building on our previously pro posed example-based EM-DETR framework, we adapt it to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets, enabling fine-grained, example driven detection across modalities. Our model achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, with image-level AUC scores exceeding previous SOTA by 1% point on four key findings in CXRs. We achieve a leading mAP50 in CXRs and mammography, surpassing EM-DETR trained on a single dataset by 2-3% points. This approach paves the way for scalable foundation models in medical imaging that leverage heterogeneous data while maintaining robust and generalizable performance.

items.title: Pyrite: Building and Benchmarking Protein-Ligand Pose Ranking Agents
items.title_zh: Pyrite：构建和基准测试蛋白质-配体姿态排序智能体
items.summary_zh: 预测配体如何与其靶标结合是小分子药物发现的核心。现代共折叠模型能生成多样候选姿态，但可靠地排序这些候选仍具挑战。我们引入Pyrite，一个成对姿态排序基准，包含跨多样蛋白质-配体复合物的1,500个姿态对。配备3D可视化工具和基于物理分数的专家化学家表现接近随机，凸显了解释可用化学信号的难度。为研究自动排序，我们引入PyriteRep，一种分子几何、蛋白质-配体相互作用和物理化学分数的结构化表示，并开发两个基于LLM的智能体：PyriteReasoner，通过基于文本的推理直接比较姿态；PyriteFeaturizer，生成可执行代码为逻辑回归构建特征，可选地纳入来自LLM子调用的特征。这些智能体分别达到高达67%和74%的准确率，超过观察到的专家表现。LLM引导的特征发现通常优于直接推理，而组相对策略优化（GRPO）改善开放权重模型，使其在我们的评估中匹配或超越闭源前沿模型。这些结果确立

extra.description: Predicting how a ligand binds to its target is central to small-molecule drug discovery. Modern cofolding models can generate diverse candidate poses, but reliably ranking these candidates remains challenging. We introduce Pyrite, a pairwise pose-ranking benchmark comprising 1,500 pose pairs across diverse protein-ligand complexes. Expert chemists equipped with 3D visualization tools and physics-based scores perform near chance, highlighting the difficulty of interpreting available chemical signals. To investigate automated ranking, we introduce PyriteRep, a structured representation of molecular geometry, protein-ligand interactions, and physicochemical scores, and develop two LLM-based agents: PyriteReasoner, which directly compares poses through text-based reasoning, and PyriteFeaturizer, which generates executable code to construct features for logistic regression, optionally incorporating features derived from LLM subcalls. These agents achieve up to 67% and 74% accuracy, respectively, exceeding observed expert performance. LLM-guided feature discovery generally outperforms direct reasoning, while Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) improves open-weight models, enabling them to match or surpass closed-source frontier models in our evaluations. These results establish Pyrite as a challenging test of pose-ranking ability and highlight LLM-guided feature discovery as a promising approach to interpret and combine the outputs of computational chemistry tools.

items.title: Continual-ARC: Measuring Skill Acquisition over a Working Lifetime
items.title_zh: Continual-ARC：衡量工作生命周期内的技能获取
items.summary_zh: 智能体框架已成为持续学习的有前景机制，与测试时参数学习并列。然而，当前基准有几个局限：它们通常聚焦单一应用领域，每个实例仅服务一次，并假设单一学习器家族，因此基于记忆和基于权重的系统很少在同一尺度上比较。我们提出Continual-ARC，一个由三个ARC-AGI版本构建的终身流，其任务无需领域知识。相同任务在休眠间隔后以新实例返回，同时新任务不断到来。在每个实例上，学习器可以支付演示、提交答案或在框架内行动，错误提交允许重试但需付费。每个实例根据消耗的反馈预算份额评分。由于学习器可在实例间保留任何内容，基于记忆和基于权重的系统在同一尺度上评分。流结束后，学习器被冻结，并在其遇到的任务的新实例上测试（衡量记忆），以及在未见任务上测试（衡量泛化）。我们在Qwen3.5-9B和GLM-5.3 Flash上运行冻结权重的智能体框架，有和无持久化，与两个提示下限、一种程序归纳方法和Qwen3.5-

extra.description: Agent harnesses have emerged as a promising mechanism for continual learning, alongside test-time parametric learning. However, the current benchmarks have several limitations: they generally focus on a single applied domain, serve each instance only once, and assume a single family of learner, so memory-based and weight-based systems are rarely compared on the same scale. We propose Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream built from the three ARC-AGI editions, whose tasks need no domain knowledge. The same tasks return after dormant gaps with fresh instances, while new tasks keep arriving. On each instance, the learner may pay for demonstrations, submit answers, or act inside the harness, with retries permitted on incorrect submissions, which are paid for. Each instance is scored based on the share of this feedback budget consumed. Since a learner may keep anything between instances, memory-based and weight-based systems are scored on the same scale. After the stream, the learner is frozen and tested on fresh instances of the tasks it met, which measures memorization, and on unseen tasks, which measures generalization. We run an agent harness with frozen weights, with and without persistence, on Qwen3.5-9B and GLM-5.3 Flash, comparing them with two prompting floors, a program-induction method and Qwen3.5-9B's weights trained to imitate GLM-5.3 Flash. Persistence in the harness generally does not improve memorization unless provided with explicit expert guidance. Most harness-based methods still learn less than a floor that simply caches each task's demonstrations, across all models we tested. No harness-based method gains on unseen tasks, whereas weight-based learning shows substantial gains. This opens the door to future weight-based continual learning that could teach models to drive harnesses in new domains.

items.title: Emergent Biological Capabilities in a Foundation Model for Molecular Interactions
items.title_zh: 分子相互作用基础模型中涌现的生物学能力
items.summary_zh: 在大型无标注语料上训练的基础模型发展出涌现能力，即超越训练目标的任务。我们将这一范式扩展到多模态生物学，提出Bonbon，一个在约3.2万亿token的配对蛋白质-配体序列上训练的分子相互作用基础模型。从单一表示空间，Bonbon在分层分辨率水平上展现三种零样本涌现能力：功能（作用机制）、残基（结合位点定位，包括正构/变构区分）和键（共价与非共价结合）。所有三种能力均泛化到分布外复合物。Bonbon仅基于蛋白质-配体序列训练，无任何任务特定监督，也无结构坐标。我们进行了跨六个模型规模（从42M到1.6B参数）的受控缩放实验；每个评估的能力在最大规模处连续指标上显示急剧跃升，即使预训练损失平滑下降。这表明仅基于损失的缩放定律不足以预测零样本涌现能力何时可用。这里报告的能力在1:2,000参数-令牌比训练后出现，以适应配对生物相互作用数据的稀疏性。相同的冻结表示以比共折叠方法快五个数量级的速度

extra.description: Foundation models trained on large unlabeled corpora develop emergent capabilities, tasks that go beyond the training objective. We extend this paradigm to multimodal biology with Bonbon, a foundation model for molecular interactions trained on approximately 3.2 trillion tokens of paired protein-ligand sequences. From a single representation space, Bonbon exhibits three zero-shot emergent capabilities at hierarchical levels of resolution: functional (mechanism of action), residue (binding site localization, including orthosteric/allosteric discrimination), and bond (covalent versus non-covalent engagement). All three capabilities generalize to out-of-distribution complexes. Bonbon was trained on protein-ligand sequences alone, without any task-specific supervision and without structural coordinates. We conducted controlled scaling experiments across six model scales from 42M to 1.6B parameters; every capability evaluated shows a sharp jump at the largest scale on continuous metrics, even as pretraining loss decreases smoothly. This demonstrates that loss-based scaling laws alone are insufficient to predict when zero-shot emergent capabilities become available. The capabilities reported here emerge after training at a 1:2,000 parameter-to-token ratio to accommodate the sparsity of paired biological interaction data. The same frozen representations achieve state-of-the-art binding and affinity prediction at five orders of magnitude greater speed than co-folding methods. In prospective wet-lab validation across nine disease targets spanning seven protein families, Bonbon achieves a 61.5% dose-response hit rate on de novo compounds, yielding structurally novel molecules not previously reported to inhibit these proteins, including for out-of-distribution targets.

items.title: TimeSeek: Multi-Task and Multi-Domain Pretraining for Generalized Time Series Analytics
items.title_zh: TimeSeek：面向广义时间序列分析的多任务多域预训练
items.summary_zh: 时间序列分析已广泛应用于各个领域。虽然现有时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）已展示出有前景的结果，但它们仍面临两大挑战：1）大多数TSFM主要依赖堆叠Transformer层来增加参数规模，缺乏从多域数据自适应建模复杂时间序列模式的能力。2）当前TSFM主要针对特定任务预训练，例如预测或异常检测，少数模型支持多任务，但未能充分利用任务特异性和共性，导致性能次优。为解决这些挑战，我们提出TimeSeek，一种新颖的广义时间序列分析模型，从多域数据自适应建模时间序列模式并在预训练中统一多任务。在概念上，TimeSeek以域和任务异质性下的选择性信息共享为指导。从多域数据角度，我们提出多域特征提取器，基于域特定特征自适应捕捉时间依赖和通道相关性，包括渐进多尺度建模和自适应槽通道建模。从任务多样性角度，我们提出多任务协同训练，通过任务定制和跨任务训练利用任务特异性和任务共性，有效在预训练中统一多任务并

extra.description: Time series analytics has been widely applied across various domains. While existing time series foundation models (TSFMs) have demonstrated promising results, they still face two major challenges: 1) Most TSFMs mainly rely on stacking Transformer layers to increase parameter size, lacking the ability to adaptively model complex time series patterns from multi-domain data. 2) Current TSFMs are primarily pre-trained for specific tasks, e.g., forecasting or anomaly detection, and a few models support multiple tasks, but they fail to fully leverage task specificity and commonality, resulting in suboptimal performance. To address these challenges, we propose TimeSeek, a novel generalized time series analytics model that adaptively models time series patterns from multi-domain data and unifies multiple tasks in pre-training. Conceptually, TimeSeek is guided by selective information sharing under domain and task heterogeneity. From the perspective of multi-domain data, we propose a Multi-Domain Feature Extractor that adaptively captures temporal dependencies and channel correlations based on domain-specific characteristics, including progressive multi-scale modeling and adaptive slot channel modeling. From the perspective of the diversity of tasks, we propose multi-task collaborative training, which leverages task specificity and task commonality through task customization and cross-task training, effectively unifying multiple tasks in pre-training and better adapting to diverse downstream scenarios. After pre-training on large-scale time series data, TimeSeek achieves state-of-the-art performance in forecasting, anomaly detection, and classification tasks across both few-shot learning and zero-shot situations, together with favorable inference efficiency.

items.title: Accurate predictions of properties of energetic materials with tabular foundation models
items.title_zh: 用表格基础模型准确预测含能材料性质
items.summary_zh: 我们使用TabPFN，一种最近开发的表格基础模型，预测含能材料的三种性质：撞击感度、分解温度和晶体密度。无需任何超参数调优，TabPFN在所有三种性质上优于已发表的最佳模型。它也显著优于广泛的成熟机器学习模型，包括调优的梯度提升（XGBoost）、随机森林和高斯过程。无论模型获得手工分子描述符还是来自Chemprop消息传递神经网络的学习表示，这一结论均成立。特别是，对于所有三种性质，应用于Chemprop自身嵌入的TabPFN比Chemprop的预测更准确。TabPFN也是我们考虑的最快模型之一，比XGBoost快一个数量级以上。由于TabPFN预测目标的整个分布而非仅单一值，它提供内置不确定性量化，我们将其与重复测量化合物的经验分布进行比较。最后，我们使用Shapley值解释预测，按重要性对特征排序。

extra.description: We use TabPFN, a recently developed tabular foundation model, to predict three properties of energetic materials: impact sensitivity, decomposition temperature and crystal density. Without any hyperparameter tuning, TabPFN outperforms the best published models for all three properties. It also substantially outperforms a wide range of established machine-learning models, including tuned gradient boosting (XGBoost), random forests and Gaussian processes. This holds both when the models are given hand-crafted molecular descriptors and when they are given learned representations from Chemprop's message-passing neural network. In particular, for all three properties, TabPFN applied to Chemprop's own embedding is more accurate than Chemprop's predictions. TabPFN is also among the fastest models we consider, more than an order of magnitude faster than XGBoost. As TabPFN predicts the entire distribution of the target rather than just a single value, it offers built-in uncertainty quantification, which we compare with the empirical distributions of compounds with repeated measurements. Finally, we interpret the predictions using Shapley values, which rank the features by their importance.

items.title: Two Communities, One Problem: Branch-and-Bound vs. A* for Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling
items.title_zh: 两个社区，一个问题：分支定界 vs. A* 用于资源受限项目调度
items.summary_zh: 分支定界（B&B）和$A^*$是分别源自运筹学和人工智能的流行精确搜索方法。尽管两种方法共享基本搜索原理，但它们探索搜索空间的不同方式可能导致显著不同的计算性能。我们以资源受限项目调度问题（RCPSP）作为示例问题设置研究这些差异。我们首先建立混合整数线性规划、状态-动作和时间Petri网表示之间的关系。由于B&B和$A^*$允许众多算法增强，我们聚焦相对基本的实现。这使我们能够检查方法之间的根本差异，而非比较最先进求解器的性能。通过使用相同的下界和最佳优先节点选择，我们隔离搜索机制的影响，特别是识别通过不同调度决策序列到达的等价状态。在480个基准RCPSP实例上的实验表明，基于图的$A^*$显著优于所考虑的B&B变体。通过额外剪枝规则，$A^*$在相同时间和内存限制下证明所有480个实例的最优性，而最佳优先B&B为445个。深度优先B&B使用更少内存，即使搜索未在时间限制内完成也能找到

extra.description: Branch-and-Bound (B&B) and $A^*$ are popular exact search methods originating from Operations Research and Artificial Intelligence, respectively. Although the two methods share fundamental search principles, their different ways of exploring the search space can lead to substantially different computational performance. We investigate these differences using the Resource-Constrained Project Scheduling Problem (RCPSP) as an exemplary problem setting. We first establish the relationships between mixed-integer linear programming, state-action, and timed Petri-net representations. Since B&B and $A^*$ admit numerous algorithmic enhancements, we focus on relatively basic implementations. This allows us to examine the fundamental differences between the methods rather than compare the performance of state-of-the-art solvers. By using the same lower bound and best-first node selection, we isolate the effects of the search mechanisms, particularly the identification of equivalent states reached through different scheduling decision sequences. Experiments on 480 benchmark RCPSP instances show that graph-based $A^*$ substantially outperforms the B&B variants considered. With additional pruning rules, $A^*$ proves optimality for all 480 instances, compared with 445 for best-first B&B under the same time and memory limits. Depth-first B&B uses less memory and can find feasible solutions even when the search does not finish within the time limit. Stronger linear programming relaxations reduce the search space but introduce considerable computational overhead. Our findings highlight the importance of duplicate-state detection and clarify the computational trade-offs between the search approaches. These insights can help researchers select an appropriate method and identify opportunities to incorporate effective mechanisms from one approach into the other.

items.title: StableProt: Structure-Aware Deep Learning for Protein Thermostability (Tm) and Environmental Adaptation (OGT) Prediction
items.title_zh: StableProt：用于蛋白质热稳定性（Tm）和环境适应性（OGT）预测的结构感知深度学习
items.summary_zh: 预测蛋白质熔解温度（Tm）和生物体最佳生长温度（OGT）对于酶工程、生物催化剂设计和宏基因组生物勘探至关重要，然而计算预测面临若干根本瓶颈：仅序列表示遗漏三级堆积；双任务耦合导致破坏性梯度冲突；自然数据库偏斜（>87%为中温菌）驱动中温菌崩溃；现有工具产生未校准的点预测。为应对这些挑战，我们提出StableProt，一个结构感知框架，通过冻结的SaProt主干将氨基酸序列与Foldseek 3Di结构令牌耦合，以捕获3D接触。分离头将热力学稳定性条件化于生态背景而无梯度冲突，而针对性14%中温菌子采样扩展嗜热菌代表性以消除中温菌崩溃。校准集成建模将校准误差降至1.92%，提供可靠的95%置信区间。在10°C温度区间评估模型揭示热极端处严重的基线崩溃，而StableProt在各区间保持稳健准确性。在ProThermDB和零样本FireProtDB上，StableProt实现最先进的概率准确性

extra.description: Predicting protein melting temperature (Tm) and organismal optimal growth temperature (OGT) is essential for enzyme engineering, biocatalyst design, and metagenomic bioprospecting, yet computational prediction faces several fundamental bottlenecks: sequence-only representations miss tertiary packing; dual-task coupling induces destructive gradient conflict; natural database skew (>87% mesophiles) drives mesophilic collapse; and existing tools produce uncalibrated point predictions. To address these challenges, we present StableProt, a structure-aware framework that couples amino acid sequences with Foldseek 3Di structural tokens via a frozen SaProt backbone to capture 3D contacts. Disjoint heads condition thermodynamic stability on ecological context without gradient conflict, while targeted 14% mesophilic subsampling expands thermophile representation to eliminate mesophilic collapse. Calibrated ensemble modeling reduces calibration error to 1.92%, providing dependable 95% confidence intervals. Evaluating models across 10{degrees}C temperature intervals reveals severe baseline collapse at thermal extremes, whereas StableProt maintains robust accuracy across regimes. On ProThermDB and zero-shot FireProtDB, StableProt achieves state-of-the-art probabilistic accuracy (CRPS = 4.52{degrees}C and 8.71{degrees}C) while recovering 92.0% of hyperthermophiles ([≥]80{degrees}C), and in prospective validation, its calibrated intervals capture both enzyme stability (75.3% coverage) and host environmental growth temperatures (78.1% coverage). StableProt is freely accessible as an interactive web server at https://stableprot.dixitlab.org/.

items.summary_zh: 昨天，多张据称来自腾讯内部微信群及职场社交平台脉脉的截图在网络传播，消息称腾讯正在酝酿新一轮大规模人员调整，整体裁员比例可能达到15%至20%，部分老项目甚至达到30%至50%。 传言场景主要来自公司 28 周年司庆大会，还涉及具体事业群，如 PCG（平台与内容事业群）裁员比例约18%，个别业务可能仅保留10%的员工。 另有消息称，相关裁员名单已经确定，部分部门开始申报。 其中最引人关注的说法是，腾讯董事会主席马化腾在内部大会上全程黑脸，措辞空前严厉，提及了裁员20%的目标。 比如，技术社区Linux DO出现题为《如何评价腾讯裁员20%》的讨论。有发帖者表示，多个微信群正在传播相关消息，但评论区同时出现20%、30%等不同版本，也有网友表示完全没有听说。 今年5月13日，腾讯总裁刘炽平在股东大会上被问及是否会大规模裁员时，曾明确回应：“肯定没有大裁员计划，腾讯跟硅谷公司不太一样。” 腾讯

items.title: 如何看待12306回应外籍游客探出高铁车厢吸烟，称「个人素质行为」无法阻止？高铁站吸烟为何难以管理？
items.title_zh: 如何看待12306回应外籍游客探出高铁车厢吸烟，称「个人素质行为」无法阻止？高铁站吸烟为何难以管理？
items.summary_zh: 近日，一段两名外籍乘客在高铁车厢门口吸烟的视频引发争议，登上热搜榜。 为此，中新网记者以消费者身份致电12306客户服务中心咨询。12306人工客服表示，高铁站台未强制禁烟，“如果旅客在车厢内吸烟，确实影响到了列车正常运行，可能会被限制乘车，或者是其他处罚。” 当记者进一步询问，若有旅客站在车厢门口，将头探出车厢外吸烟，是否涉嫌违规？12306人工客服回应称，“这个属于旅客个人素质的行为，我们没有办法去阻止旅客的这种个人行为。如果确实影响到列车正常运行，会有相应处罚。” 对此，列车工作人员是否有义务进行劝阻？12306人工客服表示，“如果看见了，肯定会去劝阻这种情况的。之后也会加强管理，包括在列车停靠的时候，增加巡视。” 据了解，《铁路安全管理条例》明确规定，禁止在动车组列车上吸烟或者在其他列车的禁烟区域吸烟。两名外籍乘客在高铁车厢门口吸烟引争议，12306回应_腾讯新闻

items.title: 奔驰 CEO 称「在中国，车要大，非常大，大得惊人」，实际情况是这样吗？为什么国内外会存在这样的区别？
items.title_zh: 奔驰 CEO 称「在中国，车要大，非常大，大得惊人」，实际情况是这样吗？为什么国内外会存在这样的区别？
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 11 日消息，据德国《汽车周刊》今天（11 日）晚间报道，中国市场的竞争，迫使奔驰调整产品和成本策略。 奔驰 CEO 康林松表示，产品规划必须完全围绕中国消费者的喜好展开。首先是车身尺寸，“在中国，车要大，非常大，大得惊人（IT之家注：原文为‘groß, sehr groß, unglaublich groß’）”。 与此同时，奔驰原则上需要实现成本结构 100% 本土化。在激烈的价格战中，仅仅把汽车放在中国生产，却继续依赖德国出口的零部件和德国方面创造的附加值，已经行不通。 按照这套思路开发的首款车型是全新纯电 E 级轿车。康林松透露，新车将于 2027 年上市。不过，从调整战略到取得成效仍需要时间，“今天作出的决定，可能要等三年、四年甚至五年后才能看到结果”。 奔驰还可以借助技术开放的 MB.OS 平台，像拼乐高积木一样灵活接入英伟达等合作伙伴的技术，满足中国、美国

items.title: 女子在西西弗书店买了200元的书，想坐咖啡区却被拒，店方称需另行消费才能入座，这一规定合理吗？
items.title_zh: 女子在西西弗书店买了200元的书，想坐咖啡区却被拒，店方称需另行消费才能入座，这一规定合理吗？
items.summary_zh: 近日，有消费者发帖称，自己在西西弗书店购买图书后，进入与书店相连的咖啡店阅读，却被店员告知咖啡区座位需单独消费，引发讨论。 11月10日，记者以消费者身份实地走访武汉多家西西弗门店发现，矢量咖啡入口处地面均贴有“消费区”标识，旁边设有“入店须知”提示牌，注明“请消费入座，一人一座”。咖啡馆内每张桌子的桌角也贴有“消费区”标识，但未进一步说明消费是否包括购买图书，也未直接注明必须购买饮品才能入座。 对于消费者在书店购书后为何不能进入咖啡区免费落座，一家西西弗门店的业务主管解释称，虽然书店与咖啡店在空间和装修上相互打通，但内部按照不同部门分别核算营收。消费者若要在咖啡店消费区落座，需购买咖啡、其他饮品或烘焙产品，在书店购书不能替代咖啡店消费。 如何看待双方观点？女子在西西弗书店买近200元书后，坐咖啡区被告知需消费入座，当场退书离店

items.summary_zh: 2026年11月11日，郭德纲在天津举办西河门摆知收徒仪式时，马志明以反对论资排辈、主张江湖无辈处的是感情为由，当场认下相识数十年的郭德纲为义子，并明确此举不入相声谱系、不改行内辈分。 近些年郭德纲跟马志明走的一直比较亲近，在郭德纲因为红歌事件的节骨眼上，俩人结干亲，是不是在为郭德纲重新复出或者说挽回名誉而铺路，毕竟马志明和常宝丰是唯二的官方相声非遗传承人。

items.summary_zh: 11月11日，“霍启山娜然 结婚”引发热议。 据半岛晨报，11日，港媒曝光娜然和霍启山婚礼请柬，两人将于12月12日在香港举办婚礼，喜帖由霍启山父母霍震霆朱玲玲署名。 2026年6月17日，霍启山与演员娜然被曝婚期临近相关词条登上热搜第一。 去年11月，网曝霍启山、娜然恋爱一年多，还一起参加婚礼。今年，2月网友在意大利美术馆偶遇两人。今年6月，网传他们将在11月于海南三亚举行婚礼。 娜然，1997年4月1日出生于俄罗斯，蒙古族，华语影视女演员、模特。 霍启山，1983年生于香港，是霍英东集团副董事长霍震霆与朱玲玲的次子，其兄为霍启刚。“霍启山娜然 结婚”引发热议！婚礼喜帖曝光，两人定于12月12日在香港完婚_腾讯新闻

items.title: 高三生在拼豆店干坐1小时，留下5元钱、道歉纸条和父母电话，为什么能引发热议？给孩子教育留下怎样的启发？
items.title_zh: 高三生在拼豆店干坐1小时，留下5元钱、道歉纸条和父母电话，为什么能引发热议？给孩子教育留下怎样的启发？
items.summary_zh: 11月8日，有网友发文称，在河南新乡封丘县的一家拼豆手工店，一名高三女生留下了一张字条和5元现金后离开。 纸条信息显示，女生8时30分出门，原本约好朋友10时出来玩。其间，她在拼豆店待了一个小时，自己想玩拼豆，但由于没带手机，便留下5元现金和纸条说明情况。记者注意到，女生在纸条上还留下了父母的联系电话。 11月10日，店主孙女士告诉记者，她家拼豆店有两间屋子，其中一间屋子24小时营业无人看守，一般两小时收费9.9元，房间内装有监控视频和她微信。11月7日没人来这间屋子玩，当天她就把视频关闭了。8日下午3点，店员把纸条和现金拍给她看，她一看就觉得这孩子“很真诚很有素质”。 当日，孙女士随即添加女生家长的微信，说明情况后退还5元，并承诺赠送女生一次全天不限时畅玩。 孙女士把钱退给家长时，家长一开始还不要，说是孩子应该给的，孙女士执意退还，还邀请女孩再来，家长答应有空带孩子来。高三女生在拼豆店干

items.title: 如何评价特朗普离任时给拜登的信？「与他在现实中的言论截然不同」指的是什么？
items.title_zh: 如何评价特朗普离任时给拜登的信？「与他在现实中的言论截然不同」指的是什么？
items.summary_zh: 美国前总统拜登的新书《答应我，美国》即将发行，他的书中记录了2021年时任美国总统特朗普离任时，给即将上任的他留下的一封信。特朗普在信中的言论，与他在现实中的言论截然不同。 据《纽约时报》11月10日报道，2021年，拜登上任第一周就告诉记者，他的前任特朗普在椭圆形办公室给他留下了一封“非常慷慨的信”。此后，拜登一直拒绝透露信的内容。 但《纽约时报》获得的节选显示，拜登在其新书《答应我，美国》中全文重印了这封信。《纽约时报》还查阅了这封信的复印件，信件日期为2021年1月20日，信封上写着“致‘46’”，指的是拜登是美国第46任总统。 这封信是用白宫信笺，用特朗普标志性的黑色记号笔写成的，其内容与特朗普此前公开谈论拜登和2020年总统大选的言论截然不同，因此显得格外引人注目。特朗普并未批评拜登，也未质疑选举结果。相反，他以近乎诗意的口吻描述了自己在白宫的工作经历，并表示他相信拜登“会忠于自

items.title: RTX5080 售价暴跌 4000 元，这波降价核心原因是什么，现在适合入手吗？
items.title_zh: RTX5080 售价暴跌 4000 元，这波降价核心原因是什么，现在适合入手吗？
items.summary_zh: 据央视财经11月7日报道：显卡是主要用于图形渲染的硬件，如今也广泛用于AI算力运算。此前受海外停产传闻刺激，RTX 50系列显卡开启连续上涨，一口气连涨11个交易日。从10月28日开始，行情突然掉头向下。RTX 5080从最高近2万元，跌到1.6万元，价格回调两成。 有商户告诉央视财经记者：“代理商、商户提前囤货，导致价格发生了很大浮动，甚至早上跟下午价格都变动很大。”尽管价格有所回落，但目前主流显卡RTX 50系列均价仍是建议零售价的1.7倍，之前较大的价格涨幅仍未消化。华强北市场硬件价格的走向，也吸引着海外采购商的目光。记者走访发现，近期海外客商密集到店询价，显卡、内存等硬件跨境采购热度明显提升。有商户称，“10月份外国客户销售额占了50%以上。” 来源：央视财经 显卡价格连涨11个交易日后急跌，RTX5080从最高近2万元，跌到1.6万元，商户：代理商、商户提前囤货，导致价格发生很大

items.title: 《GTA6》官方确认主机版目标帧率只有30帧，你怎么看？
items.title_zh: 《GTA6》官方确认主机版目标帧率只有30帧，你怎么看？
items.summary_zh: Rockstar 官方发文确认，《GTA6》现已向所有预购玩家开放预载，游戏在本世代主机上的目标帧率为 30FPS，官方推文还附带了一段 30 秒的实机短片。 按 R 星披露的信息，本作是专为本世代主机从零开发的，30 帧是为了充分挖掘硬件上限、还原雷奥奈达州那个高密度高细节的开放世界。PS5 Pro 会有专属的画面强化，借助 PSSR 超分技术提升清晰度，并且独占光追阴影效果。普通 PS5 版本则完整适配 DualSense 的高精度触觉反馈和 Tempest 3D 空间音频，加载速度也做了优化。 其他几个细节：游戏支持 Xbox 云游戏，可以在 Xbox Series X|S 和 Xbox One 上通过云串流游玩，云游玩表现受网络条件影响；同时完整支持 PS 与 Xbox 平台的远程游玩功能。

items.title: 搬家公司9公里收费13900元，不给钱就扣货威胁，能怎么规避这种「套路搬」团伙？遇到这种情况该怎么办？
items.title_zh: 搬家公司9公里收费13900元，不给钱就扣货威胁，能怎么规避这种「套路搬」团伙？遇到这种情况该怎么办？
items.summary_zh: 近日，南京王先生搬家，和客服反复核对后敲定一口价。谁知工人把所有物件装车，对方就找各种理由漫天加价，还放出狠话施压：“你家就在这跑不掉，除非你把房子卖了！”警方梳理近三千条警情，发现不少受害者遭遇雷同，顺着线索深挖，打掉两个存在亲属关联的家族式“套路搬”恶势力团伙。据警方介绍，团伙线上投放低价搬家广告接单，物品装车后坐地起价，靠扣货、言语胁迫这类软暴力强迫交易，有的费用翻十倍；有一单仅八九公里，竟索要13900元。 团伙注册多家空壳公司，盗用其他搬家公司名号抢占平台广告，上网搜搬家首页跳出来的商家，可能一半以上都属于这伙人，三年涉案总营收约800万元，近百名嫌疑人落网，骨干成员已移送起诉。搬家公司9公里收费13900元，不给钱就扣货，威胁“你家就在这跑不掉”…警方打掉两个家族式“套路搬”团伙，近百人落网
